cards.title: Official hierarchy — ADR-011
items: L0 Governance → L1 Agent → L2 Instruction → L3 Skill → L4 Docs → L5 Tool → L6 Implementation → L7 Verification.
Agent owns outcome; Skill owns procedure; Instruction owns mandatory constraints; Docs own durable knowledge/design; Tool provides capability.
The hierarchy expresses responsibility/precedence. Operational loading normally reads the smallest relevant Docs before executing the Skill.

cards.title: Shared bootstrap — every routed task
items: 1) .github/copilot-instructions.md — global routing/governance.
2) CherryMon.agent.md + intent-specific Agent — constitution and authoritative outcome owner.
3) Matching .github/instructions/*.instructions.md — mandatory constraints.
4) docs/00_HOME.md → smallest relevant docs/** set — requirement/design/domain evidence.
5) Matching .github/skills/*/SKILL.md when a repeatable procedure applies → Tool/implementation/verification.

cards.title: BusinessAnalyst.agent.md — requirement readiness
items: Writes docs/backlog/requirements/REQ-*.md when durable requirement material is needed.
Owns READY_FOR_DESIGN / READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION; does not own design, code or final test verdict.

cards.title: SolutionArchitect.agent.md + architecture-design Skill
items: Agent owns design readiness; Skill owns current-state → target design → migration/validation → ADR/synchronization procedure.
Canonical meaning lives in docs/architecture/** and docs/adr/**.
Archify is mandatory where the synchronization contract applies; Draw.io is supplemental/editable only.

cards.title: Indicator Management + indicator-onboarding Skill
items: Agent owns lifecycle outcome; indicators.instructions owns invariants/safety; Indicator Engine docs + ADR-002 own architecture.
Skill runs Discover → Metadata/Config → Targeted Backfill → Validation handoff through CherryMon MCP/calcEngine.
Legacy .github/agents/Instructions/Indicator_Engine.md is retired; historical detail is retained under docs/reference only.

cards.title: Chart Agent + chart-authoring Skill + Flint
items: Chart Agent owns recommendation/spec/render outcome.
chart-authoring owns the visualization/Flint procedure; Flint MCP provides execution capability.
Production integration hands the contract to GeneralCoding and then TestEngineer.

cards.title: GeneralCoding ↔ TestEngineer
items: GeneralCoding owns IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_VALIDATION and may use duckdb-migration/data-quality Skills when applicable.
TestEngineer owns PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/REGRESSION and uses regression-testing/data-quality-validation Skills.
Implementation FAIL/REGRESSION may return for bounded repair; no self-certified PASS.

cards.title: Repository ownership
items: .github/agents/** = outcome ownership; .github/instructions/** = mandatory constraints; .github/skills/** = reusable procedures.
docs/** = durable engineering/domain knowledge; src/** = runtime implementation; tests/** = executable verification.
MCP/scripts/CLIs/connectors = tool capability; generated architecture HTML = presentation output only.

cards.title: Runtime migration boundary
items: This Harness refactor does not big-bang move legacy runtime packages.
src/cherrystock/** remains the target layered runtime package; legacy modules migrate feature-by-feature under the architecture backlog.
